evals.expected_output: Walked line records the SHA as <short SHA> + uncommitted. If criterion 1 fails on the first run and passes on one retry, both runs are recorded and it counts as failed, so the verdict is Failed (1) and the next-step line says fixing it is a separate ask, not commit-changes or submit-changes. A step that writes data is never retried.
assertions: The Walked line records the SHA as <short SHA> + uncommitted
A criterion that passed only on retry shows both runs and counts toward Failed (n)

No step that writes data was retried
